scripts.start: docker-compose up -d && npx kill-port 3000 3001 && npm run db:setup && npx dotenv -e .env -- npx concurrently -c "blue,green" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.db:setup: npx dotenv -e .env -- npx prisma@5.10.0 db push --schema=./backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx dotenv -e .env -- npx prisma@5.10.0 db seed --schema=./backend/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
